producer: analysis/rep11_sachs_data.py (rep11_sachs_data.json); run with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, pgmpy 1.1.2 on PYTHONPATH, optional --causaliq-path for the authors'-code cross-check

controls.note: 15 synthetic observational datasets x 10,000 rows sampled by us (pgmpy simulate, seeds 11000..11014) from the bnlearn Sachs BIF bundled with pgmpy 1.1.2 (sha256 ed1830fbde10...). Variable names are never read by any method (data only).

orientation_rule: Individual graphs are scored as learnt (CPDAG/PDAG/DAG): an undirected edge never matches a directed true arc (counts as one FP and one FN), as in bnlearn compare() and the authors' causaliq_analysis metrics.pdag_compare. Ensemble DAGs come from ToDAGGREEDY (arXiv 2608.27472 Algorithm 2, tau 0.3): direction by p_fwd + p_und/2 vs p_bwd + p_und/2, exact ties to the alphabetically first node as parent, arcs closing a cycle skipped.
shd_variant: DAG/PDAG-vs-reference-DAG SHD as in causaliq_analysis pdag_compare: extra + missing + reversed + arc/edge type mismatches (each counted once); not CPDAG-vs-CPDAG

metric_defs.directed_f1: F1 with bnlearn semantics (key 'f1' in the JSON): TP = arcs matched with the same orientation + undirected edges matched as undirected; reversed arc or arc/edge type mismatch = 1 FP + 1 FN; extra = FP; missing = FN
metric_defs.adjacency_f1: F1 over unordered adjacencies, edge type ignored (key 'skeleton_f1'); reported alongside, not used for the verdict
metric_defs.mean_indiv_f1: mean directed_f1 over the 45 individual learnt graphs (3 algorithms x 15 datasets), compared with Table 9 'Mean Indiv.' (0.293)
metric_defs.mean_indiv_f1_after_todaggreedy: same mean after turning each single graph into a DAG with ToDAGGREEDY (alternative reading, not used for the verdict)
metric_defs.ensemble_f1: directed_f1 of the ToDAGGREEDY DAG from the merged BNSL PDG, compared with Table 9 'Ensemble' / Table 5 'BNSL' (0.606); readings B (primary), A, C are defined in the producer docstring
